summary: The existence check ran upstream of digestExemption in validateActionabilityAuditDetailed, so an exempt path could never be deleted. Fixed by deciding the exemption on the resolved workspace-relative path BEFORE File.Exists; workspace containment in resolveEvidencePath is untouched, so an escaping locator is still an error.
cost: one ordering change; the surrounding doctrine took longer to write than the fix

summary: The validator and check-audit-bindings.py disagreed on the EXEMPT PATH SET, not just the existence rule: #56 exempted three untracked readiness roll-ups in Python only, so the same citation was notBound there and 'evidence file is missing' here.
